objective: Build explicit signed, aligned, and affine families on the same ternary scopes. Determine their pinned decision complexity, space charged to the input, and which local evidence can distinguish them.
status: Proved: A single uniformly constructible signed prefix for each variable count encodes strict 3-SAT in its later switches. Aligned literal signs and affine equations have polynomial-time decision algorithms on the same ternary scopes. Switch-only minimally constrained sets are exactly the complete guard blocks of minimal unsatisfiable source clauses.
title: Decision with fixed ternary overlaps and supplied switch values
